We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic molecule given only task description: "Within a laboratory context, you have a sample of an organic molecule. Determine its SMILES notation carefully, using minimal but sufficient analysis." No data provided. We need to get experimental data via tools: mass spec, NMR, IR. We need to decide which to run. Since we have no prior info, we need to start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe NMR to deduce structure. Use minimal experiments.

We can run mass_spectrometry_spectra.
